messages:
maria-docs: Quick sync: we need a lightweight migration checklist + smoke tests for v1->v2 migration notice. Short and scannable.

sam-sdk: I can sweep SDK snippets and push PRs to replace client.v1 calls. Will also add deprecation log in the shim.

maria-docs: Scope: docs pages with /v1/ paths, SDK READMEs, examples in quickstarts, and any deploy/webhook samples.

eli-qa: Proposing a CI job docs/snippet-health that runs 4 snippets: py/golang/js/ts. Capture stdout+exitcode.

maria-docs: Good. Failing artifacts should go to artifacts/docs-snippet-health/<thread_ts>. Include embedding dim check and streaming signature test.

sam-sdk: Note: streaming API changed signature (onChunk vs onmessage). I'll update the TS example and add a tiny comment explaining the mapping.

noah-web: Web team will add redirects for /v1/* -> /docs/migrate-v2 (302) for 90 days then 301. Filing ticket now: WEB-8831.

ci-bot: CI job docs/snippet-health scheduled by @eli-qa

maria-docs: Draft deprecation banner: "Redwood API v1 will be retired 2026-05-15. See /docs/migrate-v2 for migration steps." Keep short.

eli-qa: Running smoke tests now; will post artifacts once done.

sam-sdk: I'll also create SDK CHANGELOG entry and a small migration snippet for switch from client.v1.invoke to client.responses.create.

maria-docs: Owners: docs PRs @maria-docs; SDK @sam-sdk; CI @eli-qa; Web redirects @noah-web. Target: merge fixes by Thu EOD, announce on Mon.

eli-qa: Results: 3/4 snippets passed. JS streaming example failed with old callback signature. Artifact: artifacts/docs-snippet-health/1799999999/js-stream-fail.log

maria-docs: Thanks. Filing quick PR to update the JS streaming example.

sam-sdk: I'll cut a follow-up patch to the shim to surface a clearer warning for users who still import client.v1.

maria-docs: Great. Once PRs land we can post the deprecation announcement. Thanks everyone :tada:
